text: Enabled -language:strictEquality across all modules and resolved every production/test compile failure intentionally. Added shared path-dependent TextIdentifier semantics plus companion CanEqual, Cats Order/Eq, Show, and Scala Ordering for opaque identifiers (including special validators), controlled unsafeFrom constructors for trusted constants, and replaced internal fold(throw)/toOption.get/value-based identifier sorting at call sites. Java Path equality and Circe null handling are now explicit. Full compile/test passed under strict equality: 296 tests; scalafmtAll, scalafmtSbt, checkFormatting, and git diff --check passed.
